settings.title: Settings
settings.memory.title: Memory
settings.memory.description: A loaded model stays in memory so generations can follow one another without waiting. Delay before unloading it:
settings.keepAlive.aria: Delay before the model is unloaded
settings.previews.title: Previews while generating
settings.previews.description: Shows the image taking shape a few times during the computation. Costs a little time and memory.
settings.lowMemory.title: Memory saving
settings.lowMemory.description: Frees the text encoder (17 GB) as soon as the prompt is encoded: the computation fits in about 9 GB instead of about 26 GB, and avoids the swapping that makes the GPU time out. A new prompt reloads the encoder from disk (a few seconds).
settings.hfToken.title: Hugging Face token
settings.hfToken.description: Most models download without an account. A token is only needed for gated repositories (LTX-2.5, for example): accept their licence on Hugging Face first.
settings.shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
settings.help.keepAlive.title: Time in memory
settings.help.keepAlive.body: After a generation, the model stays loaded in memory for this delay, so the next one starts at once. "Right away" frees the memory immediately (useful if you run other demanding applications); "Never" does not unload the model automatically. Reloading a large model from disk takes a few seconds to a minute.
settings.help.previews.title: Previews
settings.help.previews.body: During the computation, decodes a few intermediate images so you can watch the image take shape. Handy to stop a generation that started badly, but these previews cost a little time and memory.
settings.help.lowMemory.title: Memory saving
settings.help.lowMemory.body: Frees the text encoder (the largest component) as soon as the prompt is read. The memory needed drops a lot, and "swap" is avoided (memory saturation that slows everything down and can even make the GPU time out). In return, a new prompt reloads the encoder from disk, a few seconds.
settings.help.lowMemory.tip: turn it on if the machine's memory is tight.
settings.help.hfToken.title: Hugging Face token
settings.help.hfToken.body: Personal key of your Hugging Face account, created in its settings ("Access Tokens"). It is stored encrypted on this computer, used only for Hugging Face downloads and search, and never shown again.
settings.help.hfToken.tip: leave it empty until a model asks for it.
